scope: Exactly one authorized canonical local source build. No product edits, Git mutation, publication, deployment, browser or production activity. Stop at the first actual child failure; no retry or log rewrite.

expected_build.expected_effect: Source-driven Bazel build should ingest the updated controller and test, stage inputs in isolation, execute declared build-helper/HH/full-source tests, assemble and verify the fresh site outputs, and write current site.receipt.json and site.log.
expected_build.copy_policy: Only after child exit 0, copy fresh site.receipt.json and site.log byte-for-byte if present and changed since invocation start. Never copy site.evidence, PNG/screenshots, or site bundle.

nonretry_policy: The wrapper starts the declared child once, captures direct stdout/stderr file descriptors, records its process result and UTC bounds, and never retries. Any child nonzero status ends this task at the first actual failure.
